US Envoy Recounts Trump's Early Call Request to PM Modi

US Envoy Sergio Gor shared an anecdote about former US President Donald Trump's desire to call Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at 6 AM. Trump reportedly believed Modi would be awake, comparing him to himself in his work habits. The story was recounted in the context of discussing India-US relations.
